goal: Extend the completed Grassland ecosystem diagram treatment to every other Map Dex entry.
acceptance_criteria: All 19 maps have an ecosystem or environment structure diagram, retaining the completed Grassland treatment.
Every unique encounter species appears exactly once in its map diagram and links to the existing encyclopedia detail.
Natural maps explain energy or magic flow and state that the diagram is not a battle-strength ranking.
Artificial, sacred, and otherworldly maps explicitly avoid presenting their structure as a natural food chain.
Undiscovered maps continue to hide ecosystem information and the existing responsive renderer remains unchanged.
No save data, existing ID meaning, battle rule, or publication setting changes.

phases.name: goal_and_boundary
phases.deliverable: Fix the remaining-18-map scope, ecological interpretation rules, checks, and stop condition.

phases.name: content_and_validation
phases.deliverable: Added map-specific diagrams, generalized checks, player notice, and cache busting; dedicated and full checks passed.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Dedicated and full checks passed; PR #138 CI succeeded from current main without conflict and was squash-merged.

phases.name: pages_and_published_verification
phases.deliverable: Main CI and Pages succeeded; published HTML, diagram data, renderer, and notice were verified.

phases.name: completion_and_stop
phases.deliverable: Final evidence is recorded, v1 waiting state is restored, and no further backlog item is selected.

published_verification: The published HTML references the all-map ecosystem diagram cache key.
The published data includes natural ecosystem pyramids and adapted structures for artificial, sacred, and otherworldly maps.
The published notice announces diagrams for all maps.
The published renderer still links diagram species to existing encyclopedia details.
stop_condition: After Phase 53 is recorded and published, do not select or start another backlog item.
